description.value: Marmot City Camp is a backcountry campsite within E.C. Manning Park, one of British Columbia's most popular parks, situated at the heart of the Cascade Mountains. As a backcountry site, it is more than 1 km from any highway or park road, and all overnight stays require a backcountry permit registerable online, by phone, or in person at the park. The park has no cellphone service; the nearest public phones are at Manning Park Resort on Highway 3.

General park-wide policies (permit required, some sites accept reservations) apply to the park but cannot be attributed to this specific unnamed campground.

enrichment_extras.notes: All overnight backcountry stays in E.C. Manning Park require a permit; registration is available at camping.bcparks.ca, by calling BC Parks, or in person at the Manning Park visitor centre, Manning Park Lodge, or Lightning Lake gatehouse. Whether Marmot City Camp specifically requires an advance reservation (as Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, and Frosty Creek do during peak season) is not confirmed by available evidence.
